headlines.headline: Nearly 60 seniors await eligibility ruling as college hoops opens preseason practice
headlines.detail: Division I teams opened official practices with the season 40 days away, but nearly 60 seniors remain in limbo over extra-eligibility lawsuits ahead of late-September injunction hearings. Nebraska, returning All-Big Ten forward Pryce Sandfort, opens exhibition play Oct. 9.

headlines.headline: NBA Media Day: Gilgeous-Alexander chases third straight MVP as training camps open Tuesday
headlines.detail: All 30 teams held Media Day Monday ahead of camps opening Tuesday and the season tipping off Oct. 20. Thunder guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is the early MVP favorite; LeBron James says he wants more than a second-round exit with the Lakers.

headlines.headline: Giants' Brian Burns tears ACL, Dolphins' De'Von Achane out for season in injury-heavy Week 3 aftermath
headlines.detail: Burns tore his ACL in Sunday's win over the Titans; Achane will miss the rest of the season after tearing his ACL in Miami's loss to Kansas City. The Giants also traded for QB J.J. McCarthy, sending a 2027 fifth-round pick to Minnesota.

headlines.headline: Florida routs No. 4 Ole Miss, vaults to No. 7 ahead of stacked Week 5 slate
headlines.detail: Florida improved to 4-0 with a 52-28 win over then-No. 4 Ole Miss; Alabama and Georgia also stayed unbeaten at 4-0. Six ranked-vs-ranked matchups highlight Saturday, including Florida at No. 25 Missouri and Alabama vs. No. 16 Mississippi State.
